knowledge.faq1Q: How are binary point volumes (PV) calculated?
knowledge.faq1A: Every direct or indirect purchase within your downline carries a point volume value. Purchases made on your Left placement leg contribute to your Left Leg Volume, while purchases on the Right placement leg contribute to your Right Leg Volume.
knowledge.faq2A: Direct referral commissions are credited to your Available Wallet Balance instantly. Binary leg matching commissions are calculated weekly on Sunday at 23:59 EST and processed on the following Tuesday.
knowledge.faq3Q: What happens if a direct referral goes inactive?
knowledge.faq3A: An inactive member does not contribute point volume (PV) for active matching rewards, and their direct sponsor bonus is suspended until they make a qualifying maintenance order of at least 50 PV.
knowledge.faq4Q: How do I request rank promotion certificates?
knowledge.faq4A: Once the system automatically promotes your account status (e.g. Diamond Director), you can head to the Support desk to submit a direct ticket request to corporate admin.

companyPolicy.title: Company's Policy
companyPolicy.subtitle: Terms & Conditions of Bhagwan Solutions
companyPolicy.instruction: Please read and acknowledge the official Company Policy guidelines below before proceeding to the Executive Dashboard.
points: Every firm of Bhagwan Group is registered with its respective department and works for the investment interests of customers.
Bhagwn Solutions is a taxable registered firm.
Investments received from customers, whether deposited in cash or directly into the company's bank account, are the complete responsibility of the company.
Customers can contact the Head Office or Branch Office for detailed information.
Any changes made to company policies will be communicated to customers through the website, mobile number, or branch office.
For any problem or complaint, customers can register a complaint through the company's complaint portal/helpline at +91 6393552408, +91 7307002373. Appropriate action will be taken on the complaint.
If the customer is unable to continue the policy installments and wants to withdraw the deposited amount, a 5% penalty will be deducted and the remaining deposited amount will be returned.
At the maturity period, customers are provided the applicable profit along with gifts.
Customers have complete freedom to withdraw from their investment according to their needs, subject to the applicable company policy/terms.
In the event of the accidental death of a customer, the determined amount will be provided to the nominee on the due date according to the company's applicable accident policy.
